ns2:course.label: 20th-21stC Spanish Studies
ns2:course.description: Examines the cultural production of 20th and 21st century Spain, with emphasis on major works, critical movements and debates. Instruction in Spanish unless otherwise noted. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours if topic varies. Prerequisite: SPAN 312 and SPAN 320 or consent of instructor.
